fact: The Government's National Data Centre in Lilongwe is built to Tier III design, with 13 empty racks for co-location, a Data Centre as a Service model letting ministries rent or lease resources, and is to host the majority of critical government systems and data.
title: Updated Environmental and Social Management Plan for the Construction and Operation of a Government Data Centre in Malawi at the Department of e-Government in Lilongwe
publisher: Public Private Partnership Commission (Digital Malawi Acceleration Project)
